title.en: An Act Providing For the Separation of Marbel 7 High School Annex Situated in Barangay Concepcion, Koronadal, South Cotabato, From the Marbel 7 High Schools (Main), Into An Independent National High School, To Be Known As the Concepcion National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Marbel 7 High School Annex in the Municipality of Koronadal, Province of South Cotabato, is hereby separated from the Marbel 7 High School (Main) and shall operate independently under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports and be known as the Concepcion National High School.

All personnel, records, assets and properties including buildings, sites and improvements thereof, obligations, funds and appropriations of the Marbel 7 High School Annex are hereby transferred to the Concepcion National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Marbel 7 National High School-Annex (Concepcion High School). Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Concepcion National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
